rationale: Strips away generic 'casino luxury' (no green/gold, no cards/suits). Introduces a ruthless, opinionated operational clarity reminiscent of high-end financial tools, physical ledgers, and Swiss print design. Designed for dense data consumption by floor managers.

tech_stack_constraints.css_methodology: CSS Variables + CSS Grid/Flexbox in a single <style> block

typography.rationale: Chivo for brutalist, commanding page headers with heavy weight (900). JetBrains Mono for ALL tables, forms, buttons, and navigation to enforce the 'internal tool / terminal' aesthetic. Tabular numbers are perfect for financial and operational data.

color_system.rules: No gradients. Flat colors only. Background is a warm ledger paper hue (--bg-canvas), active content surfaces are stark white (--bg-surface). Structural borders are solid black (--border-hard).

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use strict CSS grid. For complex layouts like tables or KPI cards, use 'gap: 1px' with a wrapper background color of '--border-hard' to create true 1px structural grid lines (border-collapse style).

component_blueprints.layout: Standard 100vh layout with a fixed left sidebar (desktop) or hamburger drawer (mobile/tablet). Main content area scrolls. Header is stark white with a 1px solid black bottom border.
component_blueprints.sidebar: Background: --bg-canvas. Right border: 1px solid --border-hard. Links are plain text, ALL CAPS, JetBrains Mono. Hover state inverts background to --text-main and text to --bg-surface. Active state gets a 4px left border of --accent-primary. Use Lucide icons (monochrome) with 1.5px stroke.
component_blueprints.stat_cards: Background: --bg-surface. Sharp corners (border-radius: 0), 1px solid --border-hard. Content: upper-case overline label (muted, 12px), massive JetBrains Mono value (black, 32px+). No shadows. Heavy 4px bottom border for a grounded, structural feel.
component_blueprints.data_table: The focal point of the app. Use 'border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;'. Every cell has a 1px solid --border-soft outline. Header row is --bg-canvas with --text-main. Text is purely JetBrains Mono, strictly left-aligned for text, right-aligned for currency/numbers. Hovering a row changes its background to --bg-canvas.

buttons.primary: Solid --text-main background, --bg-surface monospace text, sharp corners, 0px radius. Padding: 12px 24px. Hover: Background changes to --accent-primary.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid --border-hard, --text-main text. Hover: Solid --text-main background, --bg-surface text.
buttons.danger: Transparent background, 1px solid --accent-danger, --accent-danger text. Hover: Solid --accent-danger background, --bg-surface text.

component_blueprints.inputs: Background: --bg-surface. Border: 1px solid --border-hard. 0px radius. Focus state: 2px solid --accent-primary, no outline. Height: 40px. Font: JetBrains Mono.
component_blueprints.vip_badges: Sharp rectangle. Solid background corresponding to tier. Instead of 'Gold/Silver', use functional ops naming (e.g., TIER 3 / TIER 2). T3 = --accent-primary bg, white text. T1 = --bg-canvas bg, black text, 1px black border.

copy_and_voice.strategy: Clinical, precise, military/financial terminal tone in Finnish. Strip away 'friendly' or 'luxurious' language. Use technical abbreviations where appropriate.

media.icons: Lucide Icons via CDN (<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>). No emojis allowed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement exactly as a single HTML file in /app/templates/index.html.
Do NOT use external CSS files, Tailwind, or Bootstrap. Write all CSS inside a <style> block in the HTML header.
Strictly follow the color system and typography guidelines defined here.
Ensure the layout relies on CSS Grid and Flexbox with CSS Variables for colors and spacing.
Retain all existing JS functionality, IDs, and view names unchanged. Only the visual presentation and copy should change.
Ensure every interactive element and key UI component has a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-poker', data-testid='btn-credit').
Replace all emoji icons with Lucide SVG icons (e.g., ).
